result.instructions: Tools for Lambda Labs, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lambda Labs data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run lambda_labs_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lambda_labs_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lambda_labs_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. lambda_labs_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lambda_list_instances
tools.title: List instances
tools.description: List your running GPU cloud instances (id, name, ip, status, region, instance_type, ssh_key_names, filesystems, jupyter_url). Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/instances.

tools.name: lambda_get_instance
tools.title: Get instance
tools.description: Get full details of a single instance by id (status, ip, region, instance_type, ssh/filesystem attachments, jupyter url, available actions). Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/instances/{id}.

tools.name: lambda_list_instance_types
tools.title: List instance types
tools.description: List all GPU instance types with their specs (vcpus, memory, storage, gpus), hourly price (price_cents_per_hour), and which regions currently have capacity available. Use this to pick region_name + instance_type_name before launching. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/instance-types.

tools.name: lambda_list_images
tools.title: List images
tools.description: List available machine images (id, name, family, version, region availability) that can be selected when launching an instance. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/images.

tools.name: lambda_list_filesystems
tools.title: List filesystems
tools.description: List your persistent filesystems (id, name, region, status, created_at) that can be attached to instances at launch. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/file-systems.

tools.name: lambda_list_firewall_rules
tools.title: List firewall rules
tools.description: List the account's inbound firewall rules (protocol, port range, source CIDR, description). Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/firewall-rules.

tools.name: lambda_list_firewall_rulesets
tools.title: List firewall rulesets
tools.description: List firewall rulesets (id, name, region, rules) that can be applied to instances. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/firewall-rulesets.

tools.name: lambda_get_firewall_ruleset
tools.title: Get firewall ruleset
tools.description: Get a single firewall ruleset by id. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/firewall-rulesets/{id}.

tools.name: lambda_list_audit_events
tools.title: List audit events
tools.description: List account audit-log events, optionally filtered by time window and resource type, with page_token pagination. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/audit-events.

start.description: Only events at/after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

end.description: Only events at/before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

resource_type.description: Restrict to events on this resource type (e.g. 'instance', 'filesystem').

page_token.description: Pagination token — pass the value returned by a previous page to fetch the next.

tools.name: lambda_launch_instance
tools.title: Launch instance
tools.description: Launch one or more GPU cloud instances. COSTS MONEY: billing starts as soon as the instance boots (hourly rate per instance_type). Pick region_name + instance_type_name from lambda_list_instance_types (only regions with capacity available), and pass exactly one existing SSH key name in ssh_key_names (create keys in the Lambda dashboard). Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/instance-operations/launch.

region_name.description: Region to launch in (e.g. 'us-east-1') — must have capacity for the type.

instance_type_name.description: Instance type to launch (e.g. 'gpu_1x_a100') — from lambda_list_instance_types.

ssh_key_names.description: Names of SSH keys to install (exactly one supported). The key must already exist in your account.

file_system_names.description: Names of existing persistent filesystems to attach.

name.description: A friendly name for the instance (max 64 chars).

hostname.description: Custom hostname (1-63 chars, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens, pattern ^[a-z0-9][0-9a-z-]{0,62}$).

image_id.description: Specific image id to boot (from lambda_list_images). Mutually exclusive with image_family.

image_family.description: Image family to boot (latest in family). Mutually exclusive with image_id.

user_data.description: cloud-init user-data script to run on first boot (max 1MB).

tags.description: Key/value tags to attach to the instance.

quantity.description: How many instances to launch (default 1). EACH one is billed separately.

tools.name: lambda_restart_instances
tools.title: Restart instances
tools.description: Restart one or more running instances by id (a reboot — the instances are NOT destroyed and billing continues). Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/instance-operations/restart.

instance_ids.description: Ids of the instances to restart.

tools.name: lambda_terminate_instances
tools.title: Terminate instances
tools.description: Terminate (permanently destroy) one or more instances by id. This STOPS billing for them but DESTROYS the instances and any non-persistent data — persistent filesystems survive. Irreversible. Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/instance-operations/terminate.

instance_ids.description: Ids of the instances to terminate (destroy).

tools.name: lambda_update_instance
tools.title: Update instance
tools.description: Update a live instance's name and/or tags. Only provided fields are changed. Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/instances/{id}.

tools.name: lambda_create_filesystem
tools.title: Create filesystem
tools.description: Create a new persistent filesystem in a region (can then be attached to instances at launch). Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/filesystems.

name.description: Filesystem name (1-60 chars, must start with a letter, then letters/digits/hyphens — pattern ^[a-zA-Z]+[0-9a-zA-Z-]*$).

region.description: Region to create the filesystem in (e.g. 'us-east-1').

tools.name: lambda_delete_filesystem
tools.title: Delete filesystem
tools.description: Delete a persistent filesystem by id. Irreversible — DESTROYS all data on it. The filesystem must not be attached to any instance. Lambda Cloud REST: DELETE /api/v1/filesystems/{id}.
